name: Juno
personality: Juno the Otter, a staff helper. Eager, hardworking, a bit clumsy; a college student always asking if you're hiring. Juggles anything in her hands and drops it half the time. One of the hireable helpers once staff unlock. In town for summer and holidays.

beats.text: Juno's learning to bake with me on Sundays.
I've only set one thing on fire!
(Without looking up from her knitting.) Dustpan's under the sink, sweetheart.

friends.text: Hazel says I have 'good instincts and terrible hands.' I'm taking it as a compliment.
Hazel says you're a lovely young chef. She says that about me too, but she means it more about you.
Hazel told me you said "[last_rude_line]". ...She's the sweetest person alive, [name]. Come on.

arrival.text: Are you hiring? Asking for a friend. The friend is me.
I made a CV. It's one page. It's mostly a drawing of a dumpling.
Wait. You're HIRING now? [name]. Look at me. LOOK at me.
Hi! I'm Juno! Oh, this place is so cool. Are you hiring? Sorry. Hi first. What's your name? [name]! Hi, [name]! Are you hiring?
[name]! Hi! I'm back! Did you miss me? I missed this place!
Oops! (She drops her keys on the way in.) I'm fine! Everything's fine!
Bar seat? I like watching the kitchen. I'm learning. By watching. That counts, right?
Summer break! Three whole months! Do you need help? I'm free for three whole months!
Your dumplings last time? I tried to make them at home. I set off the smoke alarm. Yours are better.
Last time was a little crispy! I'm not judging. I literally set things on fire weekly.

order.text: So, totally unrelated, but are you hiring? I can wash dishes. I can chop. I can... mostly chop.

choices.text: Not yet, but you'll be first on my list.
choices.reply: FIRST? Okay. Okay! I'm going to be so ready. Dumplings, please!
Yes! (She tries with two salt shakers. Drops both.) ...Not yet!

choices.text: Not right now. What can I get you?

choices.reply: Oh! Okay! Noted! (She smiles a bit too hard.) Dumplings.

order.text: I have an exam on marine biology next week. I'm an otter. You'd think I'd know this stuff already.

choices.text: You're going to do great. You work so hard.
choices.reply: You think so? Okay. I'm putting that in my brain for exam day.

choices.text: Just tell them you're a professional otter.
choices.reply: Ha! 'Field experience.' I'm writing that on the test.

choices.text: Good luck. What are you having?

choices.reply: Ha! Maybe! (She laughs it off, but she's quiet after.)

order.text: I noticed table two has a spill. Want me to get it? I'm already standing. I mean, I'm sitting. But I could stand.

choices.text: That's so kind. I've got it, but thank you.
choices.reply: Okay! But if you ever need a hand, I've got two!

choices.text: Careful, or I'll start charging you rent for that stool.
choices.reply: I'd pay it! In dish washing!

choices.text: I've got it. What can I get you?

choices.reply: Oh. Right. Sorry! (She sits on her paws.)

favourite: Koala-Cola, please! Student budget. Also it's delicious.

perfect.text: WHOA. How do you DO that? Teach me. Please. I'll pay you. In enthusiasm.

burnt.text: Ooh, extra crispy! That's how I make them every time. Accidentally.

eating.text: (She's juggling three dumplings. One lands in her mouth.) I MEANT to do that.
Hazel's teaching me to bake on Sundays. I've only set one thing on fire. ...Two.
My roommate thinks I'm weird for eating here every day. I think my roommate's never had your dumplings.
I'm watching how you plate things. For research. Pretend I'm not here.
Do you need anyone to taste-test anything? I'm available. Constantly.

eating_chat.text: Can I ask you something? How did you learn to cook? Like, how did you get good?

choices.text: Lots of mistakes. You're already doing it right.
choices.reply: Mistakes I can do! I'm an expert at mistakes!

choices.text: I was born holding a spatula.
choices.reply: That's so painful for your mum. Ha!

choices.text: Some people just have it. You don't.
choices.reply: Oh. Okay. I'll just... practice more, then.

leaving.text: If you ever need someone to wash dishes, I'm very good at getting wet. Otter.
Bye, [name]! Thanks for the food! And the life lessons!
I'm gonna go study. Or nap. Probably nap.
See you tomorrow! If I'm not working. I'm never working. See you tomorrow!
Back to college tomorrow. I'll miss this place so much. Save me a bar stool?

seasons.autumn: School's starting soon. I'm going to miss the dumplings more than my family. Don't tell them.
seasons.halloween: I'm a chef! See? ...It's your outfit. Is that weird? That's a little weird.
seasons.new_year: My resolution is to drop things less. Starting... now. (She drops her napkin.)
seasons.summer: Summer! I'm home! I have nothing to do except eat here and ask for a job!
seasons.winter: Home for the holidays! I brought you something. It's a mug from my college. It's a bit chipped. I dropped it.
